description: A secluded waterfront house with floor-to-ceiling glazing throughout, designed so that every room holds the sea view. The master suite opens through two sets of bifolding doors to a private elevated terrace; a freestanding sculptural tub and an open shower bordered by drainage pebbles both face the water.

The material palette — raw concrete walls, Pennsylvania bluestone floors and European white oak cabinetry — was described by Soren Rasmussen as "a refined version of the natural materials in the environment": glazing referencing the transparency of the water, wood and stone connecting to the surrounding forest and rocky foreshore. The house was published internationally by Trends.
note: This page is a work in progress: this published house may be the Parker Island Residence or the Sunshine Coast Retreat under another name — the family will confirm — and its photography has not yet been recovered.
